On the raw scale the same checkpoints are indistinguishable from an inert robot over an identical seeded 300-step rollout: REDQ -3826.77, Dreamer -3836.79, ARS -3887.55, against -3775.76 for zero actions and -3857.06 for uniform random ones (tests/test_phase1_behaviour.py pins this).
